latest.title: Backend for Frontend (BFF): Agregação de Microsserviços e Mitigação N+1 com AWS AppSync
latest.description: Uma análise profunda sobre a implementação do padrão Backend for Frontend (BFF) para resolver a latência e o acoplamento cliente-servidor em arquiteturas de microsserviços. O artigo detalha a construção de uma camada de agregação GraphQL na borda utilizando o AWS AppSync, integrando adaptadores baseados na Arquitetura Hexagonal via AWS Lambda.  O material é direcionado a arquitetos de soluções focados em otimizar e unificar a experiência de consumo de APIs em ecossistemas corporativos complexos.

latest.title: Build a Custom Jira Cloud Action Integration for Amazon Quick Using the OpenAPI Specification
latest.description: Learn how to build a custom Jira Cloud action integration for Amazon Quick using the OpenAPI Specification. This integration unifies Jira Software (project management) and Jira Service Management (ITSM) in a single connector — enabling service request creation with custom fields, JQL-based issue search, and service desk operations not available in the built-in Atlassian Jira Cloud action integration.

latest.title: Deep Dive on Managing Bedrock (In. Claude Code over bedrock) with AWS Budgets + Tags
latest.description: A detailed manual that walks through setting up a complete per-developer cost attribution system for Amazon Bedrock, using AWS Cognito for authentication and IAM session tags for cost tracking. It is designed for teams who want to monitor how much each developer spends on Bedrock API calls (e.g., Claude model invocations), broken down by individual user identity.

latest.title: 🚀 Mastering the Production Crunch: Deploying a Multi-Service AI WAFR Agent on AWS Fargate
latest.description: This log details the tense, one-day production deployment of an AI-powered AWS WAFR platform. Orchestrated via 13 AWS CDK CloudFormation stacks, the multi-service architecture integrates a security scanner, GenAI, a graph database, PostgreSQL, Redis, and React. A routine launch became a 6-hour troubleshooting marathon, exposing 9 critical failures across container networking, configuration, Lambda packaging, and AI integration. It offers the engineering community an unfiltered, battle-tested post-mortem.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
